releaseNotes:
### 14.4.11.1

* Fixes native libraries that required macOS 26; the minimum supported macOS version is now 14.0. (GH#3813)

#### Imaging

* Fixes an exception when drawing a clipped image onto another image in the cross-platform .NET package. (GH#3832)

#### OCR

* Fixes a crash when OCR with several languages reads a word differently in each language. (GH#3786)

#### Office

* Fixes Markdown-to-PDF conversion producing raster pages with no extractable text. (L#GDPIC-1660)
* Fixes PowerPoint tables using the "No Style, No Grid" table style being rendered with black cell borders. (L#MAMBO-2132)
* Fixes right-to-left text order and column-break layout when converting Word documents to PDF. (L#MAMBO-2045)
* Fixes Word documents failing to open with InvalidParameter when a table cell spans zero grid columns. (L#MAMBO-2136)

#### PDF

* Fixes PDF text extraction joining a label with the text it covers, and dropping characters from widely spaced rows. (GH#3847)
* Fixes PDF text extraction losing characters a font maps to spaces, and the paint order of rotated text. (GH#3857)
* Fixes title metadata preservation and annotation placement when editing PDF tags. (GH#3627)

#### Templating

* Adds HTML placeholder values to Office templates, rendered in Word as formatted text, lists, links, tables and images. (L#OFTAPI-28)
